name: MonarchSearchResults
title: SearchResults
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchSearchResultItem (androidx.compose.material3.ListItem) rows under headings, with MonarchSkeleton, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState for the states
summary: Search results in labelled groups with counts, highlighted matches, a summary TalkBack reads when it changes, Show all buttons, and loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: Under a MonarchSearchBar or on a search screen, to show what a search returned, grouped by type such as Documents and People.
whenNotToUse: For one result row on its own use MonarchSearchResultItem. For suggestions while typing put rows in MonarchSearchBar's content slot.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchSearchResults(groups: List<MonarchSearchResultGroup>, onSelect: (MonarchSearchResult, MonarchSearchResultGroup) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, query: String = "", loading: Boolean = false, failed: Boolean = false, errorMessage: String? = null, loadingRows: Int = 4, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onShowAll: ((MonarchSearchResultGroup) -> Unit)? = null, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), emptyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSearchResultsLabels = MonarchSearchResultsLabels())
public class MonarchSearchResultGroup(title: String?, id: String, results: List<MonarchSearchResult>, total: Int? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

public class MonarchSearchResult(title: String, id: String, path: List<String> = emptyList(), snippet: String? = null, titleRanges: List<TextRange>? = null, snippetRanges: List<TextRange>? = null, snippetMarkTags: Boolean = false, fileName: String? = null, meta: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

public class MonarchSearchResultsLabels(summary: ((count: Int, query: String) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: ((query: String) -> String)? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, retry: String? = null, showAll: ((group: String, total: Int) -> String)? = null, groupCount: ((total: Int) -> String)? = null, groupName: ((group: String, total: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: groups
options.description: Results in groups; a group with a null title has no heading, for results without groups. Groups without results are left out.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the results. Give them a bounded height.

options.name: query
options.description: What the person searched for: its words are highlighted and it is named, trimmed, in the summary and the empty title.

options.name: loading
options.description: A search is running: skeleton rows when there are no results yet, otherwise the results stay and the summary reads Searching….

options.name: failed
options.description: The search failed: the error state replaces the results.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The reason, shown under Search failed.

options.name: loadingRows
options.description: Skeleton rows while loading with no results.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Try again to the error state.

options.name: onShowAll
options.description: Adds "Show all 24 in Documents" after a titled group whose total is larger than its results.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list.

options.name: emptyIcon
options.description: An icon for the empty state. Decorative.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; counted strings are functions.

states.name: ready
states.description: The summary line, then the groups with headings, counts and highlighted rows.

states.name: refreshing
states.description: Results stay; the summary reads Searching….

states.name: loading
states.description: Skeleton rows, hidden from TalkBack; the summary is not drawn but is announced.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState of the filtered kind with "No results for “query”" and a hint.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchErrorState with Search failed, the message and Try again.

appearance: The summary is in the caption type and muted text; headings are in the subheading type with the count in muted caption text. Rows, skeletons and the empty and error states are the existing Monarch components, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web results are one Tab stop with arrow keys between them; on Android each result is a ListItem button in a LazyColumn and TalkBack moves through them in order, with heading navigation on group headings. The web's heading level, custom empty node and link component are not offered; href becomes onSelect. The web shows results without groups when given results; here pass one group with a null title. The web's onShowMore on each group is one onShowAll callback. Meta is a string in the caption type, as on iOS, not any node. Monarch bundles no icons, so the empty state's magnifying glass is the emptyIcon slot.
accessibility: The summary is a polite live region that stays in the tree: the result count, Searching…, the empty title or Search failed is announced when it changes.
Group headings have heading semantics and are read with their count, such as "Documents, 24 results"; the icon is decorative.
Each result is one button read as its title, location path, snippet and meta (MonarchSearchResultItem).
Skeleton rows are hidden from TalkBack.
The empty and error states keep their own semantics (heading titles, the Try again button).
Rows and the Show all and Try again buttons have 48dp touch targets; text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A total smaller than the results shown is raised to the number shown.
An error wins over results and loading; results win over loading.
A query of only spaces is treated as no query in the summary and the empty title.
Counts use the digits and grouping of the configuration's locale.
The list scrolls itself and takes at most the height it is given: do not put it in another vertical scroll; give it the rest of the screen.

examples.title: Grouped results
examples.template:
MonarchSearchResults(
    groups = listOf(
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            title = {{groups.0.label}},
            id = {{groups.0.id}},
            total = {{groups.0.total}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Inbox, contentDescription = null) },
            results = listOf(
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    title = {{groups.0.items.0.title}},
                    id = {{groups.0.items.0.id}},
                    path = listOf({{groups.0.items.0.path.0}}, {{groups.0.items.0.path.1}}),
                    snippet = {{groups.0.items.0.snippet}},
                    meta = {{groups.0.items.0.meta}},
                ),
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    title = {{groups.0.items.1.title}},
                    id = {{groups.0.items.1.id}},
                    path = listOf({{groups.0.items.1.path.0}}),
                    snippet = {{groups.0.items.1.snippet}},
                ),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            title = {{groups.1.label}},
            id = {{groups.1.id}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Calendar, contentDescription = null) },
            results = listOf(
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    title = {{groups.1.items.0.title}},
                    id = {{groups.1.items.0.id}},
                    path = listOf({{groups.1.items.0.path.0}}),
                    meta = {{groups.1.items.0.meta}},
                ),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            title = {{groups.2.label}},
            id = {{groups.2.id}},
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Users, contentDescription = null) },
            results = listOf(
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    title = {{groups.2.items.0.title}},
                    id = {{groups.2.items.0.id}},
                    snippet = {{groups.2.items.0.snippet}},
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    onSelect = { result, _ -> /* open result.id */ },
    modifier = Modifier.height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 6),
    query = {{query}},
    onShowAll = { /* open the full list of it.id */ },
)

)

examples.title: A failed search
examples.code:
MonarchSearchResults(
    groups = emptyList(),
    onSelect = { _, _ -> },
    failed = true,
    errorMessage = "The search service did not answer.",
    onRetry = { /* search again */ },
)
